scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compare raw and packed64-size/stride tensor access for serial-per-row Float32 matrix-vector products
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: r_i = sum_j m_ij*v_j, with nested packed access m[i][j] and independent positive row/column/vector/result strides.
scientific_intent.discretization: 257x131 and513x257 contiguous row-major cases plus129x65 packed strides(137,2), vector3,result2; raw version of last case uses same logical values in contiguous storage.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All1798 logical row results checked versus independent Float64 dots at native1e-3 absolute tolerance;129 output-padding guards exact. Full358140-value actual input/metadata prefix exact across all20 saved artifacts; no aggregate-only acceptance.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Three named study fixtures and20 kernel launches/path, six separately timed paths, not original8192x8192/1000 default CLI.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Device data/serial accumulation Float32 explicit muladd aligns native nvcc default contraction. Integer size/stride metadata Int64. CPU oracle Float64; metadata serialized as exact small Float32 headers is not device metadata precision.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Dense matrix-vector products with tensor views arise in scientific array computations; no original application dataset or end-to-end solver provenance is asserted.

native_to_julia_mapping.reason: Same one-row/thread256 and serial Float32 dot/muladd arithmetic.
